serviceWorkerPolicy: Normal registration in a fresh isolated Chromium context for each condition; no persistent user profile.

visualReview.method: Each of the 18 durable PNG files was opened directly with view_image after the final probe completed.
observations: The total 337, library title and search remain visible while the catalog reaches its bottom.
All five reported empty-icon cases show the intended nonempty symbols.
Dark and light themes keep readable category labels and icons at desktop, tablet and mobile widths.
At 200% text, labels wrap within the existing sidebar width and the catalog remains independently scrollable.
The canvas/results frame remains side by side on 1024 and 900 px tablets and stacked on narrower widths; this audit measures frame usability rather than full diagram fit.
